intro_subtitle: Let me just start from the {color=#3730A3|beginning}...

cafe_shifts.text: I worked {color=#3730A3|closing shifts} at a café until {color=#3730A3|9:30 PM} and took the bus everywhere because I couldn't afford a car.

cramped_apartment.text: My roommate was always late on rent in our {transform_scale=0.85,1.0|cramped} apartment, and I vented most nights to {color=#0F766E|Claire}.

daniel_regular.text: {color=#4E4440|Daniel} worked late nearby and stopped in at 9:15 for {gradient_stops=0:#2C1608,4:#7C3F18,8:#B87333,12:#2C1608_speed=2.5|hot chocolate}. We knew each other from small talk at the counter.

missed_last_bus.text: One {jitter_radii=0.025,0.025|{color=#0369A1|{shadow_color=#BAE6FD_offset=-0.06,0.06|freezing}}}, rainy night, closing ran ten minutes late and I {color=#3730A3|missed} the last bus with no cash for a cab.

first_ride_home.text: {color=#4E4440|Daniel} pulled out of the lot, saw me {jitter_radii=0.03,0.03|{color=#0369A1|shivering}} under the streetlight, and offered a ride since it was on {color=#4E4440|his} way.

night_pickups.text: {color=#4E4440|He} started showing up at 9:25 with {gradient_stops=0:#2C1608,4:#7C3F18,8:#B87333,12:#2C1608_speed=2.5|hot chocolate} in the cupholder so I wouldn't {color=#0369A1|freeze} at the bus stop.

outgoing.weekend_hugs: Everything felt {wave_a=0.06_f=0.4|{color=#B45309|so easy}} back then. Like someone was finally looking out for me.

insisted_on_rides.text: When I told {color=#4E4440|him} I wanted to walk or take the bus, {color=#4E4440|he} {color=#991B1B|wouldn't leave} the lot until I got in the car.

weekend_hugs.text: We started spending weekends together. {color=#4E4440|He} always met me at the door with a long, {wave_a=0.07_f=0.4|{gradient_stops=0:#7C2D12,3:#C2410C,6:#D97706,9:#7C2D12_speed=2.5|warm hug}}.

outgoing.quit_cafe_rest: {color=#3730A3|Wait...} how was I paying rent if I hadn't moved in yet?

moved_in_together.text: When my roommate moved out and rent {jitter_radii=0.025,0.025|{color=#991B1B|spiked}}, {color=#5E3F3F|Daniel} offered to let me {wave_a=0.06_f=0.4|move into} {color=#5E3F3F|his} apartment.

no_rent_insistence.text: Even when I offered to split costs, {color=#5E3F3F|he} {color=#991B1B|insisted} I didn't need to pay a dime of rent.

quit_cafe_rest.text: I quit those {color=#3730A3|exhausting} late shifts at the café, and {color=#5E3F3F|Daniel} covered the bills without hesitation so I could {wave_a=0.06_f=0.35|{gradient_stops=0:#7C2D12,4:#B45309,8:#D97706,12:#7C2D12_speed=2|finally rest}}.

pushed_to_quit.text: {color=#5E3F3F|He} kept {color=#991B1B|pushing} me to quit the café, saying it was {swing_a=3_f=0.4|{color=#3730A3|ridiculous}} for me to work nights when {color=#5E3F3F|he} could pay for everything.

stuck_alone_indoors.text: With no job and no car, I spent most of my days {color=#3730A3|alone} inside {color=#5E3F3F|his} apartment.

drifted_from_claire.text: Life got busy, and {color=#0F766E|Claire} and I {wave_a=0.06_f=0.35|{color=#3730A3|lost touch}}.

outgoing.moved_out_of_town: Those months are kind of a {wave_a=0.07_f=0.4|{color=#3730A3|blur}}...

called_claire_toxic.text: {color=#6E3737|Daniel} kept calling {color=#0F766E|Claire} {color=#991B1B|toxic} and {color=#991B1B|draining} until I agreed out loud that I was better off without {color=#0F766E|her}.

reading_my_texts.text: {color=#6E3737|He} was {color=#991B1B|reading} my texts over my shoulder and {color=#991B1B|questioning} why I replied to anyone.

blocked_bedroom_door.text: When I tried to go out anyway, {color=#6E3737|he} {color=#991B1B|{shadow_color=#FECACA_offset=-0.06,0.06|blocked}} the bedroom door until I apologized for being {swing_a=3_f=0.4|{color=#3730A3|ungrateful}}.

warm_after_canceling.text: The moment I {color=#991B1B|canceled} my plans and said sorry, {color=#6E3737|he} turned {gradient_stops=0:#7C2D12,2:#C2410C,4:#7C2D12_speed=2|warm} again.

outgoing.owed_him_sex: I really don't want to think about this...

owed_him_sex.text: Sex became something {color=#6E3737|he} was treating like I {color=#991B1B|owed} {color=#6E3737|him}.

pinned_and_bruised.text: When I said I was tired or pushed {color=#7E2D2D|him} off, {color=#7E2D2D|he} {color=#991B1B|pinned} my wrists and {color=#991B1B|gripped} my arms until they {color=#6B21A8|bruised}.

stopped_fighting_bed.text: {color=#7E2D2D|He} {color=#991B1B|didn't stop} until I quit fighting and just {color=#3730A3|laid still} on the bed.

hot_chocolate_in_bed.text: {color=#7E2D2D|He} brought {gradient_stops=0:#2C1608,4:#3F3F46,8:#18181B,12:#2C1608_speed=1.5|hot chocolate} to bed, stroked my hair, and said {color=#7E2D2D|he} only did it {swing_a=3_f=0.35|{color=#9A3412|out of love}}.

moved_out_of_town.text: To get out of the city noise, we moved into a {color=#3730A3|quieter} apartment {color=#3730A3|further out} of town.

no_bus_only_his_car.text: Out there, there were {color=#991B1B|no} bus lines and only {color=#7E2D2D|his} car, so if I wanted to leave, {color=#7E2D2D|Daniel} had to drive me.

phone_repair_offer.text: When my phone broke, {color=#7E2D2D|Daniel} took it to a repair shop so I wouldn't have to {wave_a=0.06_f=0.35|{color=#B45309|worry}}.

outgoing.two_days_to_fix: {color=#3730A3|Two days} for a cracked screen... I never even questioned why it took so long.

two_days_to_fix.text: It took {color=#7E2D2D|him} {color=#991B1B|two whole days} to {swing_a=2.5_f=0.35|{color=#3730A3|"get it fixed."}}

secret_job_apply.text: I {color=#0369A1|secretly} applied for a part-time job on my phone while {color=#7E2D2D|he} was at work.

found_out_yelled.text: {color=#8C2222|Daniel} found out about the application without me telling {color=#8C2222|him}. {color=#8C2222|He} {jitter_radii=0.04,0.04|{color=#991B1B|yelled}} that I didn't trust {color=#8C2222|him} and {color=#991B1B|refused} to drive me.

withdrew_apologized.text: I withdrew the application and apologized, feeling {color=#3730A3|guilty} for being {swing_a=2.5_f=0.35|{color=#3730A3|ungrateful}} after all {color=#8C2222|he'd} done.

restaurant_proposal.text: {color=#8C2222|He} took me out to an {gradient_stops=0:#7C2D12,3:#B45309,6:#D97706,9:#7C2D12_speed=2|expensive} restaurant and got down on one knee with a {gradient_stops=0:#B45309,2:#D97706,4:#B45309_speed=2|ring}. Of course I said {pulse_a=0.08_f=0.6|{color=#B45309|yes}}.

forced_yes_in_public.text: The restaurant was packed and every table was {pulse_a=0.07_f=0.6|{color=#991B1B|watching}} when {color=#8C2222|he} asked. I {color=#991B1B|forced} myself to say {jitter_radii=0.03,0.03|{color=#991B1B|yes}} in front of them.

city_parents_dinner.text: We drove back into the city for dinner with {color=#8C2222|his} parents and stopped at a store for wine and flowers.

outgoing.restaurant_proposal: {color=#3730A3|No, wait...} I was already wearing the ring at that dinner.

claire_grocery_runin.text: Inside the grocery store, we ran into {color=#0F766E|Claire}. {color=#0F766E|She} asked why I texted months ago to {color=#991B1B|end} our friendship.

never_sent_that_text.text: My {jitter_radii=0.03,0.03|stomach dropped} because I {color=#991B1B|never} sent that text. {color=#8C2222|Daniel} smiled and told {color=#0F766E|her} I was just overwhelmed with wedding planning.

fingers_digging_side.text: {color=#8C2222|His} arm wrapped around my waist, fingers {jitter_radii=0.04,0.04|{color=#991B1B|digging}} into my side to keep me {color=#991B1B|quiet}.

claire_saw_bruises.text: Through my sleeve, I saw {color=#0F766E|Claire} staring down at the faded {color=#6B21A8|bruises} on my wrist.

acted_normal_drive.text: On the drive back to the apartment, {color=#8C2222|Daniel} acted like {color=#3730A3|nothing} had happened.

counter_mugs_hug.text: {color=#8C2222|He} set two mugs of {gradient_stops=0:#2C1608,4:#3F3F46,8:#18181B,12:#2C1608_speed=1.5|hot chocolate} on the counter and pulled me into a hug.

bitter_sip_stomach.text: Slipping out of {color=#8C2222|his} arms, I took a sip, and the {gradient_stops=0:#2C1608,4:#7C3F18,8:#B87333,12:#2C1608_speed=2.5|sweet chocolate} tasted so {jitter_radii=0.04,0.04|{color=#4D5E2A|bitter}} my {jitter_radii=0.03,0.03|{color=#4D5E2A|stomach turned}}.

awake_left_morning.text: I laid {color=#3730A3|awake} all night. Once {color=#991B1B|he} left for work, I {color=#0369A1|packed} a bag and called {color=#0F766E|Claire} from the main road.

river_walk_call.text: While {color=#0F766E|Claire} and I walk along the {wave_a=0.07_f=0.4|{color=#0369A1|river}} near {color=#0F766E|her} place, {color=#991B1B|Daniel} calls.

always_know_where.text: {color=#991B1B|His} calm act vanishes: "I know you called {color=#0F766E|Claire}. I {color=#991B1B|{shadow_color=#FECACA_offset=-0.06,0.06|always know}} where you are."

threw_phone_in_river.text: I tell {color=#991B1B|him} to {color=#991B1B|go to hell}, hang up, and throw the phone straight into the {wave_a=0.08_f=0.5|{color=#0369A1|river}} so {color=#991B1B|he} can {pulse_a=0.06_f=0.6|{color=#0369A1|never}} trace me.
